working_notes: This repo is content-only; the site build/deploy is handled in pir2pir-docs-site.
Pushes to production trigger a rebuild in the engine repo via GitHub Actions.
docs/legal/consent.md must remain a standalone document: 152-FZ requires consent to be separate from the terms of use.
Russian is the binding version of every legal document; translations carry a precedence note.
The Telegram bot links to these pages from its consent screen — keep registry/links.json in sync.
